# DJ Radu

> Independent wedding and party DJ (Radu Ghiorghiu), based in Juelsminde, Denmark. Plays weddings, christenings, birthdays, confirmations, corporate events and Romanian community parties across Denmark and northern Germany, in Danish, English, Romanian and Italian.

DJ Radu brings his own sound and light equipment (JBL PartyBox, ADJ Fusion FX Bar), plays a mix of international, Romanian and Latin music (salsa, bachata, house), and takes song requests from guests during the event. CVR 46538560.

## Partners

- [Christening fairies (Romanian Ursitoare) in Denmark](https://djradu.com/en/christening-fairies/) (en), [da: eventyrfeer til barnedåb](https://djradu.com/da/eventyrfeer-til-barnedaab/), [ro: ursitoare la botez](https://djradu.com/ro/ursitoare-botez/): DJ Radu recommends Mascote Vesele (Sønderborg, https://mascotevesele.dk) for the Ursitoare, three fairies of fate who give the baby personal wishes at the christening party, plus church decoration and Photo Booth 360. Phone +45 27 69 71 48. The pages explain the tradition and its Bulgarian, Serbian and Greek counterparts.
